about.title: The Story of Kamru Ghati Honey
about.subtitle: Founded in 2020 amidst the pristine landscapes of Mandi, Kamru Ghati Honey was created to share genuine mountain apiculture.
about.section1Text: Mandi, often called the 'Varanasi of the Hills', lies nestled along the banks of the Beas River in Himachal Pradesh. The surrounding valleys—rich with seasonal wildflowers, medicinal flora, and terraced agricultural belts—provide a natural habitat for apiculture. Kamru Ghati Honey was founded here in 2020 with a straightforward mission: harvest and supply pure honey that retains the authentic character of Himalayan flora.
about.section2Text: Unlike mass-market supermarket honeys that are aggressively heated, ultra-filtered, and blended from industrial syrup, each batch of Kamru Ghati Honey reflects its specific seasonal bloom. From the high-altitude cold desert valleys of Lahul and Spiti to the post-monsoon ajwain belts and seasonal jamun flowering, each variety carries distinctive colors, aromas, and textures.
about.section3Text: In an industry crowded with exaggerated health claims and misleading certifications, we stand for quiet honesty. We do not claim our honey cures medical ailments, nor do we display unverified badges. Every jar is honest, pure bee honey packed with utmost care.
about.transparencyBoxText: We are proud of our ongoing journey as a regional family business. As official FSSAI registrations, GST records, and laboratory profile reports are renewed and formalized for digital display, they will be updated directly on this page.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear, factual answers about our honey, crystallization, ordering, and delivery.
faq.q1: Why does natural honey sometimes crystallize?
faq.a1: Crystallization is a completely natural physical process that occurs in pure honey. It depends on the natural ratio of glucose to fructose and storage temperature. Crystallized honey has not spoiled; placing the jar in warm water (below 40°C) gently restores its liquid form.
faq.q2: Are there any added sugars, corn syrups, or artificial flavors?
faq.a2: No. All Kamru Ghati Honey varieties are 100% pure floral nectar gathered by bees. We never add artificial sugars, corn syrup, or flavorings.
faq.q3: How can I order and pay?
faq.a3: Select your desired variety and size on our website, then click 'Enquire on WhatsApp'. We will confirm current availability and courier charges to your PIN code, and provide UPI, bank transfer, or QR code payment details.
faq.q4: Do you deliver to all locations in India?
faq.a4: Yes, we ship across India through standard courier services. Remote locations may take a few additional days depending on courier accessibility.
faq.a5: We pack in 250g, 500g, and 1kg sizes. Availability for specific sizes varies depending on the floral harvest batch.
